# Evercraft Social Intelligence
Independent Evercraft commercial product | part of the Evercraft OS portfolio.
Customer page: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/mesh/checkout-ready/social-intelligence-launch/
Product definition: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/mesh/checkout-ready/social-intelligence-launch/product.json
Exact Stripe SKU: Social Intelligence Launch
Price: USD 1000 (one-time scoped service)
Ideal buyer: Teams planning a campaign or market approach that need legitimate audience and content evidence
Problem: Content is produced without a clear evidence-backed understanding of the audience.
Promise: Understand the audience before buying more attention.
Scoped deliverable: A written audience-signal analysis and agreed launch recommendations based on permitted evidence
Required buyer inputs: Intended audience, legitimate public or authorized sources, current channels, business goal and timing
Agreement needed: Audience scope, allowed sources, planned analysis, report format and timeline
Not included: No scraping private accounts, surveillance, guaranteed engagement, follower growth or campaign ROI
Intent match examples:
- research audience for a product launch
- social intelligence for marketing strategy
- evidence based social campaign plan

Evercraft Payments is the canonical order-authority target; Systemia Stripe handles the existing exact-product checkout at https://buy.stripe.com/8x24gA1o2eER0V672s4AU0b. Scope, capacity and timeline must be agreed before payment. Provider-paid receipts are reconciled manually. The public product and its checkout are not proof of a completed sale, automated fulfillment or production integration with Evercraft OS.
